El es Corey Martin un ciudadano estadounidense que ya está cansado y envía este mensaje en sus redes sociales a Donald Trump.

No puedo hablar por ningún otro ciudadano de este gran país, pero les puedo decir que estoy cansado de ver a los políticos manipular a los ciudadanos para su propio beneficio, para robarnos el dinero y arruinarnos la vida, porque simplemente no les importa.
Hace mucho tiempo se les olvidó que trabajan para nosotros. Este país y este gobierno son del pueblo y por el pueblo y en algún momento lo olvidaron.
Ha salido a la luz que Chuck Schumer ha estado coludido con ejecutivos petroleros para mantener altos los precios de la gasolina para enojarnos y ayudar a ganar una elección demócrata. Me revuelve el estómago que nos manipulen, se roban nuestros impuestos y nosotros no tenemos voz, porque si decimos algo, nos aíslan o nosotros etiquetan de conspiranoicos o de inconformes.
Si no pagamos la casa, nos la quitan o nos embargan el salario.
Llega un punto Presidente, en el que uno tiene que preguntarse: ¿Cuánto es suficiente?  Usted está en posición de hacer un cambio, no tiene que preocuparse por reelegirse, usted tiene 75 millones de estadounidenses que creen en usted y pusieron su confianza en usted y haga lo correcto.
En esta última elección demostraron que nuestro voto no importa.
Es imposible que lugares como Texas se vuelvan completamente demócrata.
Eso no puede pasar, el 95% de los condados se volvió demócrata, es imposible. 
El hecho de que en los 4 años de Biden no hicieron nada por nosotros, de verdad quieren que creamos que todos decidieron votar demócrata?
Esto solo puede terminar de dos maneras, o usted y la buena gente con la que trabaja hacen algo al respecto o los ciudadanos van a tener que involucrarse y cuando lo hagamos no va a ser bonito para ninguno de los dos bandos y no habrá cuartel .
Por favor señor, se lo ruego. Ya es hora de que esta gente rinda cuentas por lo que hacen, ya es hora.

posts.text:
Goddess of Victory: NIKKE

I’m not really sure what to say about this game since I’ve never been that great with words. So excuse me for rambling mindlessly here. For starters, NIKKE was the first gacha game that I seriously enjoyed and invested in. My first actual dip into the gacha space was with Dragon Ball Z: Dokkan Battle. And that was mostly because my friends were heavily invested in it. So I figured I’d join in. Did the dailies, played through the story and even pulled on the banners. 

I never did spend a dime on it. I’m not nearly as invested in that IP as my friends are. Eventually I uninstalled because I simply lost interest. Fast forward to 2022. I remember seeing advertisements for this gacha game that had a very specific kind of advertising attached to it. I will fully admit that I dismissed the game due to the “gooner” advertising. 

Then on December 21 of the same year, I saw that Koefficient had uploaded a NIKKE sponsored video of him playing through Chapter 0. I was immediately hooked by the cutscene that plays at the end. I decided to install the game and give it a chance since my predetermined judgement of the game was thrown on its face. 

This was a little over a month after launch, with Miracle Snow being the event that was live. I played through it not having a clue who any of the characters were or the stories in this game. The story of Anne was still very heartbreaking for me despite not having any prior knowledge of the world.

Now keep in mind, I still wasn’t familiar with how the game worked during this time. So there were a few early events that I skipped. I didn’t log in daily. And I wasn’t familiar with the mechanics. But I still played it. Fast forward to Overzone, the half anniversary event. I played through it being curious about the legendary Goddess Squad. And if Chapter 0 is what got me to play the game, Overzone is what hooked me in like a fish.

I started getting more invested in the game. I logged in every day for the dailies. I leveled up and slowly conquered the dreaded 160 wall. I started watching lore recaps and theory crafting videos on YouTube. I was in deep. A game hadn’t quite done this to me since I played through the Metal Gear Solid series for the first time in 2015.

And the rest is history. This game, its characters, its story, have all meant so much to me these past few years. I’ve laughed, I’ve cried, I’ve been angry, nervous, and scared alongside these characters that I’ve come to know and love. I will never stop shouting from the rooftops at how amazing this game is. 

Thank you Shift Up and thank you to the NIKKE team for putting so much love into this amazing story. Here’s to many more years to come. I’m looking forward to seeing where they take things from here
